name: Ahab
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesied a lie in His name, the Most High would deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar to be slain before the captives' eyes.

note.label: Jeremiah 29: The Letter to the Captives

points: They would become a curse, the Lord make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire, because they committed villainy in Israel, committed adultery with their brothers' wives, and spoke lying words in His name.

note.label: Jeremiah 29: The Letter to the Captives

cases.charge: Prophesying a lie in the name of the Lord among the captives at Babylon; committing villainy in Israel and adultery with their neighbours’ wives
